extracted.intended_audience: UIC investigators (faculty, postdocs, researchers) seeking grant-funding support
extracted.subtask_description: Information about the University of Illinois Chicago Office of Research Development services and expectations for investigators seeking funding, including finding opportunities, team-building, proposal development, limited submissions, and training. Geared toward investigators preparing or planning sponsored research proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission focus: advance sponsored research across disciplines
rubrics_metrics.description: The mission of Research Development is to advance sponsored research across all disciplines at UIC, with special focus on large or complex, interdisciplinary projects that enhance knowledge in new ways.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The office works closely with the Office of Corporate and Foundation Relations for non-federal funding and sponsorship programs; emphasis is placed on projects that are institutionally significant or prestigious.

rubrics_metrics.name: Early-stage proposal development support
rubrics_metrics.description: Research Development provides support to investigators in the early stages of proposal development.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support activities include identifying funding opportunities, identifying collaborators and other campus resources, connecting investigators with government consultants, and facilitating team-building and ideation workshops.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal preparation support for large or prestigious programs
rubrics_metrics.description: For large institutionally significant or prestigious programs, Research Development occasionally supports proposal preparation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Such support can include project management and editing of proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Find Funding / funding portal usage
rubrics_metrics.description: Investigators should use the Research Development funding portal to browse current opportunities and learn about campus processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The portal displays current opportunities and internal letter of intent (LOI) deadlines; it's the primary tool for locating funding and seeing internal timelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limited submissions management and internal review requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Limited Opportunities are programs where a sponsor restricts the number of applications an institution may submit; these require an internal UIC review process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interested applicants must follow the internal review process so the campus can determine which investigator will be approved to apply. Check the funding portal for internal LOI deadlines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Build your team / collaborator identification
rubrics_metrics.description: Research Development helps investigators build teams by identifying collaborators across campus and facilitating team-building activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Team-building support includes ideation workshops and connecting investigators with relevant campus resources and partners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-award, proposal review, and post-award support services
rubrics_metrics.description: Campus units provide coordinated pre-award proposal development services, proposal review services, and post-award management services to support sponsored projects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Office of Research Development lists these services alongside the Grant Management Office to indicate handoffs from proposal development to award management.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training opportunities to improve grant communication and skills
rubrics_metrics.description: Research Development offers training to help investigators become better communicators, grant writers, and advocates for their research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples of trainings include NSF CAREER Proposal Development Series, Research and Scholarship Storytelling Bootcamp, Faculty Profile Workshop, and Responsible Conduct of Research (RCR) workshops for postdocs and faculty.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resources for Diversity, Equity, and Engagement in Research
rubrics_metrics.description: The office provides resources specifically focused on diversity, equity, and engagement in research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These resources are listed as part of the Research Development offerings to support inclusive research practices and engagement with diverse communities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internal funding and awards information
rubrics_metrics.description: Research Development aggregates information about internal funding opportunities and awards available to campus investigators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Investigators can consult internal funding listings (via the portal) as part of planning and matching projects to potential sponsors.
